The '''LCK 2019 Summer''' was the second split of the 2019 [[League of Legends Champions Korea]] season, organized by Riot Games in collaboration with KeSPA. The competition took place in Seoul, South Korea, from June 5 to August 31, 2019, with all regular season matches held offline at LoL Park and the Finals hosted at Korea University Hwajung Tiger Dome. The Regular Season was played in a Double Round Robin format with Best-of-Three matches, while the Playoffs followed a Single Elimination King of the Hill format with Best-of-Five series from Round 1 onwards. Ten teams competed for a ₩275,000,000 KRW prize pool, with the split champion qualifying for the [[World Championship/2019|2019 World Championship]]. [[Jin Air Green Wings]] and [[KT Rolster]] secured their spots through the [[LCK/2019/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion Tournament]]. Matches were played from Patch 9.11 through Patch 9.16.

==Format==
*'''Group Stage''' - ''June 5 - August 18''
** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st place''}} advance to the Finals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''4th and 6th place''}} advance to the Wild Card Round of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''6th till 8th place''}} qualify for [[LCK/2020/Spring|Spring split]].
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''9th and 10th place''}} will have to play in the [[LCK/2020/Spring/Promotion|Spring Promotion Tournament]].
*'''Playoffs'''
** Single Elimination King of the Hill.
*** Wild Card match is {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
*** Round 1 onwards is {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
** Winner qualifies for [[World_Championship/2019|Worlds 2019]]

*'''MVP Points'''
** Regular Season & WildCard, Playoffs R1-R2 | 100pts
** Finals | 300pts
